svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: H — Chunky toy diorama · Thrills & Chills round-3 art concept
svg.text: Painted wooden toys on a plastic tray, shot close with a
tilt-shift lens. Big-head peg-doll guests, stubby fat rides,
rounded board edges, flat satin paint in primaries.

g.text: Every object = 3 flat paints + 1 bevel line.
No outlines. Guests: peg body + ball head (42%).
Board: rounded slabs, blue tray, water inside.
Tilt-shift = blur outside a horizontal band.
Satin highlight: one white oval per ball.
